questions.question: In what village were James and Lily Potter killed?
questions.note: Harry and Hermione visit in winter. The Potters' cottage still stands, ruined, with a sign from well-wishers.

questions.question: Who has Nagini been disguised as when Harry visits that village?
questions.note: The old historian of magic. She leads Harry upstairs, and the snake is inside her body.

questions.question: What shape is the sign of the Deathly Hallows?
questions.answer: A triangle, a circle, and a vertical line
choices: A triangle, a circle, and a vertical line
questions.note: Xenophilius Lovegood wears it when the trio visit his house. It stands for all three Hallows at once.

questions.question: Who tells Harry, Ron, and Hermione the Tale of the Three Brothers?
questions.note: Hermione reads it from Beedle the Bard in his house. He has already betrayed them, hoping to get Luna back.

questions.question: What is the Elder Wand supposed to make its master?
choices: Able to raise the dead for good
questions.note: The oldest brother asked Death for a wand that would always win. Its loyalty passes when its master is beaten or disarmed, not only when he is killed.

questions.question: What does the Resurrection Stone actually show?
questions.answer: A shade of someone who has died
choices: A shade of someone who has died
The person, alive and solid again
questions.note: The second brother used it to bring back a girl he loved. She was sad and cold, not truly alive, and he killed himself to join her.

questions.question: On what night does Voldemort murder James and Lily?
questions.note: The first film opens on that attack. Harry is left on the Dursleys' doorstep the next day.

questions.question: What does the marker Harry chooses for Dobby's grave say?
questions.answer: Here lies Dobby, a free elf.
choices: Here lies Dobby, a free elf.
Master has given Dobby a sock.
questions.note: They bury him by hand at Shell Cottage. Harry will not use magic for the grave.

questions.question: Who tortures Hermione at Malfoy Manor?
questions.note: She panics when she sees a sword and thinks it is the one from her vault. Greyback is in the room. Dobby is the one who gets them out.

questions.question: Who stole the Elder Wand from the wandmaker Gregorovitch?
questions.note: Voldemort's vision shows the theft. Dumbledore later beat Grindelwald and took the wand himself.
